import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 3000010;
    static int p, k, t;
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[MAXN];

    static void dfs(int x) {
        used[x] = true;
        int to = (int)(((long) x * k) % p);
        if (!used[to]) {
            dfs(to);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        t = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (!used[i]) {
                t++;
                dfs(i);
            }
        }
        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < t + (k == 1 ? 1 : 0); i++) {
            ans = (ans * p) % 1000000007;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
